external_reference.source: Zurbuchen et al. (2013) Energy harvesting from the beating human heart by a mass imbalance oscillation generator
external_reference.measured_value: Average 16.7 μW from cardiac motion in sheep (in-vivo)
external_reference.why_relevant: This is a published in-vivo measurement of cardiac harvesting power. If our model's P50 (10 μW) is in the same order of magnitude as this measurement, our harvesting assumption is reasonable.

frozen_criterion.pass_condition: Detailed model P50 uptime >= 95% AND model harvest assumption within order-of-magnitude of published reference (5-50 μW range)
